title: ‘Posh George,’ the Convicted Fraudster in Nigel Farage’s Inner Circle
summary: Scrutiny over the gifts and support provided by George Cottrell to Mr. Farage, the Reform U.K. leader, will continue even after he won last week’s special election in Clacton.
